versions.title: First Rocks
versions.summary: Rock to Riches joins the launcher: turn a single rock into a glowing factory.
versions.intro: Rock to Riches is a factory game about turning plain rocks into a fortune. Drop rocks on a belt, run them through machines to raise their value, sell them, and spend the money on bigger and better things.

sections.title: New
items: 528 factory pieces|Belts, droppers, machines and sellers, each with its own look and animation.
Upgrade tree and rebirths|Spend gems on lasting upgrades, then start over stronger.
A living world|Day turns to night, lamps come on, and grass slowly grows back around your factory.
Five game modes|Casual, Normal, Difficult, Hardcore and Sandbox.
Safe saves|Your factories stay safe through updates, and backups are kept for you.
